what: v006 (and v003-v005) built their day-by-day numbers over every calendar date that had any price bar, including Sunday evenings and holidays, which have overnight trading but no 9:30-16:00 session. On a Monday, 'yesterday's close' was Sunday's, which does not exist, so the overnight gap was blank and the strategy silently skipped every Monday and every day after a holiday. The same empty dates put zero-volume days into the 14-day volume average, so 'above average volume' really meant about 0.83x of the true average.
how_found: Round 8, while the AI was porting v006 to TradingView's Pine Script (journal title: 'bug fix found while porting to Pine'). The journal records only that it was found during the port; it gives no further detail. The Pine file keeps an input 'Skip days after a non-session day (replicates v006)', off by default.
affected_versions: v004, v005, v006 skipped Mondays (0 Monday trades in-sample); v003 traded Mondays but had the diluted volume average (journal: 'v003-v005'). v001 and v002 do not use these daily series.

evidence.v006_volume_reference_note: v006's 14-day 'average opening volume' divided by the true 14-session average, per in-sample session (mean 0.825): the journal's '~0.8x'.

before_after.note: OOS figures are from results.md (2024-09-01 to 2026-01-28). Fewer trades after the fix because the volume bar is now honestly 1.0x; the added Mondays roughly wash.
